name: Rosario to Vampire Capu 2: Koi to Yume no Rapsodia
original_name: ロザリオとバンパイア 恋と夢の狂想曲
source:
The school called Youkai Gakuen High School Tsukune entered is actually for monsters. But there are a lot of pretty girls. One day, Ginei plans to hold a school festival called "The Youkai Fes". The story just goes on involving the Otonashi sisters. But days later, Tsukune suddenly starts having an erotic dream every night. How come...?

[From HimeyaShop]
